task: round 18 scan_hyp_new_levers: NEW BIGGER LEVERS (retrain-family and fusion) for >= +0.002 public within 2 days
summary: Honest answer: no new lever has P(public >= +0.002) above ~10-15%. The retrain family is 0 for 5 on our LB (exp08 -0.016, friend A -0.025, exp23 -0.007, exp03B -0.003, soup -0.004), and imissher measured a synthetic-adapted secondary at -0.008 on the 0.947 stack. exp71 turned out to be a very small nudge: rel L2 0.3-4.4% on 3 modules, plus a detect_head bias shift that x138's per-frame mean/std alignment cancels. Its dummy moved nodes -0.16% and forks 75 -> 80. So exp72 is most likely to display 0.954. Only ONE new item is worth building now, because it is nearly free: N1, a delta-extrapolation dose rung (ExPO-style theta0 + 2*(theta_ft - theta0)). It needs no training GPU, only CPU plus one ~0.5 GPU-h dummy, and it is submitted only if exp72 reads UP. N2 (a longer or stronger fine-tune run as two recipes on the two idle T4s of one session) is also conditional on an exp72 UP. Everything else does not reach the bar or re-proposes a closed family: the head-only primary FT (feature-safe for V1284 but value-bounded), synthetic pretraining (I-120), gated fusion or WiSE interpolation (I-126/I-335) and a DeepCenter retrain (no trainer, asymmetric downside). Plan issue: pre-register the exp72 decision table now and move exp74 (Corwin secondary) behind exp72's read. The best existing odds remain exp75 (coordinject, P(>= 0.955) ~0.35 per check_coord_refiner.json). Research-round cadence so far (REPORT.md headers): r10 15:16Z, r11 17:05Z, r12 20:00Z, r13 22:45Z, r14 01:45Z, r15 05:30Z, r16 08:30Z, r17 11:00Z, r18 ~15:20Z. Gaps are 1.8-4.3 h, median ~3 h; the last gap was 4.3 h.

findings.what: N1 DELTA-EXTRAPOLATION DOSE RUNG (task-vector scaling; new, not in IDEAS). exp71x2 weights = theta0 + 2*(theta_ft - theta0) on the 10 changed keys (decoder_blocks.1 conv/BN affine, unet.head, detect_head); BN running stats unchanged; optional reserve k=3. MECHANISM: exp71 is a first-order small step (lr 1e-5, 1 epoch, rel L2 <= 4.4%), so ExPO-style extrapolation approximates a 'longer/stronger' distilled FT without training. x138 re-aligns secondary logits per frame (mean/std, clamp 0.5-2), so the bias part cancels and k scales only the shape change. ARITHMETIC: if exp72's true effect is e1, k=2 gives ~2*e1 in the linear regime. To reach +0.002 display, e1 >= ~+0.001 is needed, i.e. exp72 must itself show an attributable UP. P(exp72 UP) ~0.2 x P(k=2 >= 0.955 | UP) ~0.5 = ~0.10 unconditional. RUNTIME: identical architecture, so the hidden run stays ~7.4-7.6 h (K2 ledger); the dummy is ~26-31 min. GATE: submit ONLY if exp72 displays >= 0.955, or 0.954 with an attributable UP (passed-teams test). Dummy: 'Secondary SHA256: <new sha>' + 'Secondary artifact: .../biohub-secft-x2-v1'; nodes within [-2%, +1%] of 121,252; forks reported, and k=2 forks should move in the same direction as exp72's 75 -> 80; 0 Traceback/FAILED/DEADLINE:/FALLING BACK; runtime <= 1,920 s. A second-order check: the k=2 dummy node delta should be ~2x exp72's -0.16%; a non-linear jump means stop. RISK: extrapolation leaves the teacher anchor that kept exp71 small; the downside is limited to one public-only slot (class C, never a final without Q3).

findings.what: N2 LONGER / STRONGER DISTILLED FT PAIR (conditional). In one T4x2 session: GPU0 = continue from ed8c616b for epoch 2 (same recipe, loader seed 271828); GPU1 = fresh 1 epoch from 9bac2fa0 at lr 3e-5 (3x). Keep the teacher-BCE, the feature MSE and the frozen BN; do NOT unfreeze more modules. The encoder feeds the secondary edge features (0.15 edge weight + edge-feature TTA), so unfreezing changes linking too; that is the exp23/imissher failure direction (-0.007/-0.008). Then train 08:15-11:30Z, dataset+build+dummy ~12:30Z, submit ~13:00Z, score ~20:30Z 28 Sep. The dummy gates are the same as N1. Of N1/N2 only the better-looking one gets a slot, chosen by its dummy node delta closest to 2x exp72's; no stacking.

findings.what: FINE-TUNED PRIMARY, V1284-safe form = detect_head-only distilled FT of the PRIMARY: unet features stay byte-identical, so the V1284 head (reads primary unet_out[:, f_idx]), lowrefine, DaughterNet and the edge predictor are unaffected; only the primary detection logits change. VERDICT: does not reach. The primary enters detection at 0.2 after alignment (0.8 is the secondary; the retention guard only switches movies to primary-only below 0.90 retention). A linear 1x1 head on fixed features under distillation moves less than exp71 did, so the expected public effect is <= ~1/4 of exp72's, i.e. far below +0.002. Any FT of the primary's decoder or encoder hits the silent V1284 OOD failure (I-097/I-107; bounded() caps at 2 um, so the guard cannot fire). Do not build.

findings.what: SYNTHETIC PRETRAINING (hikaggler) stays closed (I-120), with fresh evidence against it on a public stack. imissher: a secondary adapted for 6 h at lr 1e-5 on 600 synthetic + 40 real videos = 0.939 on the 0.947 stack (-0.008). hikaggler's +0.012 was on his own 0.939-era model, not a public-stack gain. y3uanm's synthetic set is non-public. A usable pretrain (>= 500 sequences) plus a distilled FT does not fit in 2 days with an honest read. Not re-proposed.

UNCERTAINTY-GATED FUSION of our FT secondary with the original is the I-126/I-335 family (deferred/refuted). Two new facts make it worse now. (a) exp71's delta is tiny, so gating between two nearly equal maps changes almost nothing. (b) Running both secondaries costs one more encode per window (~+25% of the GPU phase, the I-156 runtime note), pushing the hidden run from ~7.5 h toward ~9 h against the safetail margin. WiSE-style interpolation (alpha < 1) only dilutes a delta that is already small. The only dose direction with any upside is alpha > 1 (N1). Not re-proposed.

The 0.25 threshold is calibrated to the current DC output distribution, so a retrain acts like an uncalibrated DC rung plus a shape change, and the public DC response is asymmetric (up: 0 at 0.20/0.225; down: -0.005 at 0.30). findings.what: Honest ceiling for this focus: nothing new reaches the old R8 standard (lab gate + dummy + OK by 27 Sep 12:00Z), and no new retrain-family item has P(public >= +0.002) above ~0.10-0.15. Our models were trained on all 199 videos, and hidden embryos differ, so there is no honest lab for any detector change; the only reads are the LB and dummy node/fork deltas. The 0.957+ teams built their own full pipelines over weeks (Corwin: SWA-trained secondary + GBM trio + MITOSE head; Quantizr: an offline-validated pipeline in 11 subs), not a 1-epoch delta on the public secondary. Rank-wise, the realistic best remaining shots are already built: exp75 (P(>= 0.955) ~0.35), division rungs by the 45/46 reads, then N1 only on an exp72 UP.
